author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
AI is expensive. AI coding agent spent lots of tokens reading code
We should write code using single letter variable and function names to reduce the tokens bill.

comments.text: Well, if you are going to have it generate code that is as readable as a 1970s-era BASIC program, why not just generate binary (or a netlist in the case of RTL)? When you go to that extreme, it means that you aren't expecting the code to be human readable/reviewable/maintainable anyway.
